about_the_game:
About

Code: Elf Contract is a tool that lets you place your own character on your computer desktop to keep you company. Your character will stay quietly on your desktop in a static form.

Goal

The main idea is to bring a more personalized touch to your desktop, while also integrating some useful mini-tools to make working on your computer more convenient.

What can “Code: Elf Contract” do right now?

In addition to having your VRM character accompany you on your desktop, I’ve built in several handy desktop widgets:

  • Music Box: Add your favorite songs to a quick playlist for easy playback.

  • Pomodoro Timer: Helps you manage your time and stay focused on work or study.

  • Daily Task List: Keep track of your daily tasks.

Current Status

I’m currently developing this project in my spare time, and this demo showcases the most basic systems. Although there’s still quite a way to go before the official release, I hope to keep improving and expanding the content through players’ hands-on experience and feedback.

In the demo, players can upload their own custom models and have them accompany them in the scene.

I sincerely invite you to download the demo and share your thoughts and suggestions with the community.

If you think this app is interesting and are curious about “Code: Elf Contract” feel free to add it to your wishlist!
